q1_issues.issue: The stated restriction "undesired" is silently dropped — (Theme sk_thwart_1 suitor) widens the claim from undesired suitors to suitors at large.

"known as a 'poison pill'" is flattened into a direct kind atom (Member sk_defence_1 poison_pill), asserting the defence IS a poison pill instead of encoding the participial post-modifier as the reduced relative the instruction set mandates.

q2_gaps: appellation predicative "known as <label>" / "called <label>" on a common-noun referent — Name is proper-noun-only, and the reduced-relative route has no licensed head for the "as"-complement
notes: Compound handling is right (genus on anti_takeover_defence, correctly suppressed on the non-compositional poison_pill), the agentless passive omits its Agent, and the participial "designed" reduced relative correctly carries no tense while the purpose infinitive takes (To design thwart). (With sk_equip_1 …) is the prepositional verb's own preposition-named oblique, so it is licensed.
